title: Choose StormCard's visual world (safer hand)
question: Familiar directions only. Pick one, or the category standard.

options.label: Laminated Emergency Card
options.lineage: The wallet-size laminated emergency / ICE card and Red Cross preparedness cards
options.thesis: StormCard is the laminated card she keeps in her purse: white, a bold red band, huge black type.
options.viewport: Phone. Red band header 'StormCard' + language switch. One big white card: 'ZÒN C' huge, the not-flood-insurance line, three shelter rows with miles and pet icon, 'Rele 311' row. Primary button: 'Kote pou m ale'.
options.risk: Plain if the type scale is timid; must commit to very large type and the red band.

options.label: Local TV Hurricane Coverage
options.lineage: Miami local-news hurricane coverage: deep blue set, white lower-thirds, yellow alert banners
options.thesis: Speaks the visual language she watches every storm on Channel 10 and Telemundo 51.
options.viewport: Phone. Deep blue ground, yellow alert bar 'PREPARE NOW', a white lower-third plate 'ZÒN C', three shelter plates, big primary button.
options.risk: Can read alarmist; the alert yellow must be reserved for real warnings.

options.label: Phone Wallet Pass
options.lineage: Apple/Google Wallet passes and pharmacy cards she already opens on her phone
options.thesis: Her plan as a pass in her phone's wallet: one tall card, one fact per row, large and calm.
options.viewport: Phone. A tall rounded pass: header strip with StormCard mark and language; primary field 'ZÒN C'; secondary rows for shelters with miles; footer row 'Rele 311'. Primary button below.
options.risk: The most generic of the three; distinctiveness lives only in type scale and the pass shape.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Executed against the FEMA app, Ready Miami-Dade and the Red Cross Emergency app, at their craft level.
canonCard.viewport: Phone. White header, zone pill, three shelter list rows with chevrons, a blue primary button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every government app by design.
